_comment: Seed for the private readiness page (SPEC addendum G2): the org lists a fresh database starts with. The gsoc list is generated by scripts/fetch_program_orgs.js from the GSoC archive (config/gsoc-2025-orgs.raw.json). The lists of every other program are STARTER lists: a small, hand-picked set of GitHub organisations known to take part, not the full or current roster. Programs change their organisations every round; review and edit them on the private page (Settings → Programs).

programs.notes: STARTER LIST. Communities that have taken Outreachy interns in recent rounds and work on GitHub. The roster changes every round (May and December cohorts): check outreachy.org for the current one.
STARTER LIST. CNCF and other Linux Foundation projects that regularly post LFX Mentorship projects. Each term (spring, summer, fall) has its own project list on mentorship.lfx.linuxfoundation.org.
STARTER LIST. Processing Foundation projects live in the `processing` organisation (p5.js, p5.js-website, p5.js-web-editor, processing4, ...).
STARTER LIST. Bitcoin and Lightning projects that have mentored in Summer of Bitcoin. The project list is published each year on summerofbitcoin.org.
No org list: MLH Fellowship selection does not depend on contributions to particular organisations. The score reflects general open-source strength (any open-source PR counts).
General signal: merged work in any major-tier open-source project. Not a program and not counted in 'students with a real chance'.
